headline: Sensex slumps 700 points and Nifty breaches 22,600 as global selloff triggers Indian market crash

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Traders expect the US Federal Reserve to hike interest rates again
A global bond selloff is rattling international and domestic markets
Surging global oil prices are putting significant pressure on equities
Concerns over whether earnings can justify high valuations in the auto sector
whatHappening: The Sensex has plummeted by 700 points while the Nifty 50 dropped below the 22,600 level
Approximately ₹5 trillion in market capitalization was wiped out during the morning session
Nifty Bank has hit a three-month low amid the broader market downturn
Gold and silver prices have seen a sharp decline over the last two days
summary:
The Indian stock market is witnessing a major crash with the Sensex falling 700 points and Nifty breaching key support levels at 22,600.
Global headwinds including rising bond yields, oil price surges, and US Fed rate hike fears are the primary drivers of the selloff.
Trillions of rupees in investor wealth have been erased as major indices and sectors like banking hit multi-month lows.
